# Synthetic fixture pairing

These two pages are project-authored test fixtures, not copies or translations of BFE content. The author explicitly declares them equivalent for pipeline testing: matching heading, paragraph, two-item list and two-row table structures express the same intentionally simple advice in German and French.

`HUMAN_VERIFIED` in the demonstration manifest applies only to this synthetic fixture relationship. It must not be represented as a verified live BFE pair.
